That reactive demand creates a dominant red layer in your electromagnetic field that's driving serious operational costs.

You're generating 527,859 BTU per hour in waste heat, requiring $15.30 every hour just for cooling overhead — that's 77 kilowatts of HVAC load just managing transformer thermal stress. About 60 to 65 percent of your operating time runs above your 2250 kVA supply target, creating consistent transformer overload conditions.

The annual impact? You're looking at approximately $402,000 in electromagnetic waste — money leaving your facility through reactive losses, thermal burden, and cooling overhead every single month.
